teacher_logit_manifest.role: text-free frozen-logit retention targets; never labels or source text

training_objective.primary_alert_score: calibrated probability from the preserved first three verdict logits; auxiliary logits are training and diagnostic signals only
training_objective.checkpoint_selection: development recall at the configured maximum FPR

policy.azsc_source_provenance: mixed consented user SMS, translated UCI, and self-generated rows; per-row provenance unavailable; excluded from licensed-real totals
policy.bare_domain_recognition: curated web TLD allowlist; schemes/placeholders unchanged
policy.real_source_privacy_normalization: emails and long phone/account-like digit sequences replaced with placeholders
policy.split_unit: masked template plus 64-bit character SimHash cluster
policy.synthetic_generation: v5 short-message grammars, targeted counterfactual v1 train-only correction families, plus v2 paired five-turn dialogue grammars across 12 scenarios, all grounded in official scam advisories; no source message text copied
policy.taskmaster_context_policy: latest complete turns capped at 425 characters; verified at no more than 150 tokens after speaker-neutral-v1 with the pinned ModernBERT tokenizer
policy.taskmaster_hard_negative_provenance: human-authored Wizard-of-Oz roleplay, weak SAFE label from legitimate task domain; counted separately from naturally occurring communications

ftc_pattern_overlap_references.external_role: BothBosu exact and SimHash contamination audit only

chichewa.purpose: post-schema-v9 multilingual diagnostic; excluded from fitting and thresholding; may inform candidate selection

source.provenance_limit: D_CHI mixes collected and augmented messages without row-level provenance

scam_dialogue.purpose: post-schema-v9 multi-turn synthetic diagnostic; excluded from fitting and thresholding; may inform candidate selection

policy.label: weak SAFE from legitimate task domain; not independently scam-labelled
policy.privacy_normalization: email, URL, and phone/account-like values replaced before materialization
policy.window_evidence: all 5,507 eligible source conversations measured at no more than 150 tokens after speaker-neutral-v1 with the pinned ModernBERT tokenizer

source.collection: two-person Wizard-of-Oz dialogues written by human participants

input_transform.application: before tokenization for fitting, evaluation, and latency

targets.mobile_latency_status: must be measured on a physical target device

latency.scope: batch-one tokenizer plus device transfer plus model forward plus probability transform; excludes SDK evidence extraction and I/O
